ActionDescriptions.ToSearchErrorMemories:
to search local error memories
Searches only the current session's scoped Error Memory semantic tag and returns bounded candidates under ErrorMemoryRoot. query - stable error message query. maxResults - candidate limit clamped to 1-25.
ActionDescriptions.ToSearchErrorMemoriesInCategory:
to search local error memories within a category
Searches only the current session's scoped Error Memory tag under one ErrorMemoryRoot descendant. query - stable error message query. categoryPrototypeName - exact local ontology category prototype. maxResults - candidate limit clamped to 1-25.
ActionDescriptions.ToValidateErrorMemoryDefinition:
to validate an error memory taxonomy definition
Validates one recursive Error Memory taxonomy branch or routable leaf before NLMemory persistence. prototypeDefinition - exactly one raw ProtoScript definition. definitionKind - Branch or Leaf. Parents may be any depth beneath ErrorMemoryRoot; leaves require scoped Error Memory tags and routing verification fields.
